rules.title: Repeated SSH authentication failures from one source
rules.purpose: Detect password guessing against sshd that produces many failures from a single address in a short window.
rules.yaml:
title: Repeated SSH authentication failures
detection:
  selection:
    program: sshd
    message|contains: 'Failed password'
  timeframe: 5m
  condition: selection | count() by src_ip > 10
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auth
level: medium
falsepositives: A misconfigured backup or monitoring client retrying an expired key.
A NAT gateway aggregating many users behind one address, which can inflate the count for a shared egress IP.
rules.tuning: Group by source address and add a username or asset scope. Raise the threshold only after measuring the normal failure distribution for the estate; do not suppress the rule globally.

rules.title: Windows failed logon burst
rules.purpose: Detect repeated failed interactive or network logons against Windows hosts.
rules.logsource: Windows Security event log, Event ID 4625
rules.yaml:
title: Windows failed logon burst
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4625
  timeframe: 10m
  condition: selection | count() by TargetUserName, IpAddress > 15
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
level: medium
falsepositives: A stale service account password causing scheduled tasks to retry.
User typos during a password change window.
rules.tuning: Exclude known service accounts only after confirming the exclusion cannot mask interactive login failures. Keep a separate lower-threshold rule for privileged accounts.

rules.title: PowerShell encoded command
rules.purpose: Detect PowerShell launched with an encoded command, a common but non-specific obfuscation pattern.
rules.logsource: Windows process creation or PowerShell script block logging
rules.yaml:
title: PowerShell encoded command
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
  selection_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -EncodedCommand '
  condition: selection_img and selection_flag
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
level: high
falsepositives: Management tooling that wraps scripts to avoid quoting problems.
Some installers and update agents use encoded commands legitimately.
rules.tuning: Decode the command in a safe, non-executing environment and baseline the parent process and signing status. Suppress by parent/child path pairs with a documented owner, not by command hash alone.

rules.title: Unexpected setuid binary execution
rules.purpose: Detect execution of a setuid binary outside the known administrative baseline.
rules.yaml:
title: Unexpected setuid execution
detection:
  selection:
    type: EXECVE
  filter_baseline:
    exe|startswith:
      - '/usr/bin/sudo'
      - '/usr/bin/passwd'
      - '/usr/bin/su'
  condition: selection and not filter_baseline
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
level: high
falsepositives: Legitimate administrative tools installed outside the baseline.
Container images with their own setuid helpers.
rules.tuning: Build the baseline from a known-good image inventory and alert on new file hashes, not only paths. Review any new setuid binary before adding it to the filter.

rules.title: Web 404 burst from one client
rules.purpose: Detect shallow path enumeration that produces many not-found responses.
rules.logsource: Web server access log or WAF
rules.yaml:
title: Web 404 burst
detection:
  selection:
    status: 404
  timeframe: 5m
  condition: selection | count() by client_ip > 50
logsource:
  category: webserver
level: low
falsepositives: Broken links after a deployment.
Legitimate crawlers or uptime monitors following stale sitemaps.
rules.tuning: Add path diversity and user-agent context. A scanner usually requests many distinct paths; a broken deployment concentrates on a few. Do not auto-block shared egress addresses without checking business impact.

rules.title: Root account activity without MFA
rules.purpose: Detect AWS root account API activity where MFA was not used.
rules.yaml:
title: AWS root activity without MFA
detection:
  selection:
    userIdentity.type: Root
    additionalEventData.MFAUsed: 'No'
  condition: selection
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
level: high
falsepositives: A break-glass procedure where MFA was unavailable and the exception was documented.
Account setup tasks performed before MFA enforcement was enabled.
rules.tuning: Confirm the event source and account. Root use should be rare and ticketed; alert on every event and review the ticket, not only the count.

rules.title: Pod with host PID namespace scheduled
rules.purpose: Detect pod creation that shares the host PID namespace, exposing host process information.
rules.yaml:
title: Pod with host PID namespace
detection:
  selection:
    verb: create
    objectRef.resource: pods
  hostpid:
    requestObject.spec.hostPID: true
  condition: selection and hostpid
logsource:
  product: kubernetes
  service: audit
level: high
falsepositives: Node-level agents that legitimately inspect host processes.
Lab clusters where the namespace is explicitly excluded.
rules.tuning: Scope by namespace and service account, and pair with admission policy. A hostPID pod in a system namespace owned by a known daemonset is different from one created by a user in an application namespace.

rules.title: Sudoers configuration modified
rules.purpose: Detect writes to sudoers files or drop-in directories.
rules.yaml:
title: Sudoers modification
detection:
  selection:
    type: SYSCALL
    key: sudoers_change
  condition: selection
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
level: high
falsepositives: Configuration management applying an approved sudoers policy.
Package upgrades that rewrite a vendor drop-in.
rules.tuning: Correlate the writing process with the configuration-management identity and change record. Review the diff; an approved tool writing an unexpected rule is still a finding.

rules.title: Unusually long DNS query name
rules.purpose: Detect query names far longer than the organization's normal distribution, a weak signal for DNS tunneling or data encoding.
rules.yaml:
title: Long DNS query name
detection:
  selection:
    query|re: '^.{80,}$'
  condition: selection
logsource:
  category: dns
level: low
falsepositives: Content delivery or antivirus lookups that encode long opaque identifiers.
Legitimate service discovery names with long labels.
rules.tuning: Measure the normal length distribution and entropy per parent domain. Alert on sustained volume or high-entropy subdomains, not a single long name. A single query is not evidence of tunneling.

rules.title: IAM policy with wildcard action attached
rules.purpose: Detect attachment of a customer-managed policy granting wildcard actions.
rules.yaml:
title: IAM wildcard policy attached
detection:
  selection:
    eventName: AttachRolePolicy
  condition: selection
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
level: medium
falsepositives: Break-glass roles created under an approved emergency change.
Infrastructure-as-code bootstrap roles with a documented scope.
rules.tuning: This rule is a change signal, not proof of excess privilege: resolve the attached policy document and evaluate its actions and resources. Pair with a policy-analysis job that flags wildcard actions on sensitive resources.
